question: Thaipusam festival is celebrated in which of the following Indian states?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tamil Nadu.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**__**Thaipusam Festival:**__

__
 
• Thaipusam is a festival mainly **celebrated in Tamil Nadu**.
 
• It is celebrated by Tamil devotees of** Lord Kartikeya (Lord Murugan)**, son of Lord Shiva and Goddess Parvati.
 
• The festival is celebrated on **Poornimani Tithi (Full Moon Day)**, which coincides with the month of Makar according to the solar calendar in North India.
 
• The word Thaipusam consists of the words **Thai and Pusam, where Pusam means Nakshatram Pusam** (also known as Pushya).
 
• This festival is celebrated with great enthusiasm in **India, Malaysia, Indonesia, Sri Lanka**, and many other countries of the world.
